title: Toolkit (<toolkit>/toolkit.toml): your own recipes, profiles, sign-ins and skills, in a folder of yours
description: Written by you, in your own folder or private repo, never in ShipShape. FleetLedger reads it from the path in ships.toml [toolkit.<id>] and checks the whole folder (contracts/toolkit.md).

instructions.description: Standing instructions for the Ship's agents, files under instructions/.

files.description: Every vendored file under files/ (release archives and the like), with its SHA-256. A file there that is not listed, or does not match, stops the toolkit loading.

toolkitId.description: A toolkit's id: its toolkit.toml id and the prefix of its tools and profiles.
